title: Cheap pub type fixes before 0.4
description:
Each a break later, S each:
1. chat-types message.rs:455,513 Message.body_type / MessageRevision.body_type String -> existing BodyType.
2. calendars-types availability.rs:49 BusyPeriod.busy_status Option<String> -> closed enum (draft L512).
3. mail-types mailbox.rs:276 MailboxFilterCondition.role Option<String> cannot send null and isn't MailboxRole; same fix as parent_id (JMAP-zx3s.17): typed tri-state filter.
4. Comparator derive(Default) gives is_ascending=false but wire default is true: contacts card.rs:588, calendars event.rs:471, tasks filter.rs:32,65.
5. graph-types edit.rs:328 GraphEditStreamEnable.data_types Vec<String>, vtc-types stream.rs:57 VtcStreamEnable.event_types -> closed enums.
6. #[non_exhaustive] on BackendQueryError (server backend.rs:740), JmapBodyFields (mime lib.rs:81), TypeTagMismatch (jscalendar lib.rs:100), RootCheckError, TreeDestroyError (chat-filenode-server), DeliveryFailure (chat-federation-server), IdentityBinding, SignatureHeaders, PeerKeySet, HubUnavailable.
7. Fixed-size pub const arrays -> &[&str]: PEER_METHODS [&str;8], SCENE_DATA_TYPES [&str;4], MANDATORY_DID_METHODS [&str;3].
8. MdnBackend::parse_mdns owned Vec<Id> -> &[Id] (mail-server mdn.rs:267).
9. types methods.rs:55 GetResponse.not_found Option<Vec<Id>> -> Vec<Id> (RFC 8620 §5.1; JMAP-6xs8.24).
10. base-client client.rs:1121 close_after Option<&str> -> typed enum (RFC 8620 §7.3 'state'|'no').
11. Remove deprecated helpers::ser, JmapError::too_many_changes, JmapError::unknown_capability.
12. scene-server private copy of push Urgency enum -> reuse the shared one.
BREAKING.
